description.value: A small provincial campground set in a scenic canyon right on Highway 20, with the glacier-blue Chilcotin River flowing past — the only BC Parks site along this stretch between Williams Lake and Tweedsmuir. A short riverside interpretive trail is a nice stretch, but the cold, fast river is unsafe for swimming.

address.value: 6 km west of Alexis Creek, Highway 20, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Bull Canyon Campground is a legitimate operational provincial park campground operated by Silvertip Park Services Ltd., situated 6 km west of Alexis Creek on Highway 20. OSM tags (internet_access=no, power_supply=no) are consistent with the website's silence on those amenities, but per the rules I cannot set these to false on OSM tags alone without explicit website confirmation. The website explicitly notes e-bikes are prohibited on trails and restricted to park roads, and cycling is permitted on roadways with mandatory helmets — neither speaks to e-bike charging infrastructure.
concerns: Seasonal closure: gates are locked from September 16 to May 14; cyclists planning shoulder-season travel will find the campground inaccessible.

The operator phone number (+1-250-320-9305) and email (parkinquiries@telus.net) listed in OSM could not be verified against the BC Parks website, which only displays BC Parks' general contact numbers. These may be correct operator contact details but are unconfirmed.
No formal civic address is available; location is described only as '6 km west of Alexis Creek, off Highway 20'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Bull Canyon Campground is the sole provincial campsite on a very long and remote stretch of Highway 20, making it a critical and irreplaceable overnight stop for touring cyclists on this corridor. The listing is fully supported by the official BC Parks website.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website explicitly states e-bikes are prohibited on trails within the park and restricted to park roads only; this is relevant for e-bike touring cyclists who should be aware of the restriction.

wow_evidence: only BC Parks site along this stretch between Williams Lake and Tweedsmuir
